name: BackRooms
detailed_description:
Welcome to Backrooms, an AI-powered SUI multiplayer online game that has been successfully launched on Steam. In Backrooms, you enter a world of artificial intelligence filled with imagination, mystery and adventure. Here are the game's highlights and features:

Backrooms is an adventure game that takes players into an infinite maze filled with surreal environments and unknown dangers. Players must navigate the maze in search of food, water, and any other supplies they can find while avoiding entities that roam the corridors.

The deeper you go into the Chamber, the more unstable the environment becomes, and the more dangerous the entity becomes. You must be prepared to run, hide and use whatever resources are available to survive.

Game Features


1. Use new technology to ensure the safety and transparency of the game.

2. An adventure-filled multiplayer online game that explores the world with other players and pushes the limits of your imagination.

3. Unique and amazing AI-based maze traversal, ready for the challenge?

4. A huge world is made up of multiple regions, each with its own mysterious setting and challenges.

5. You earn virtual currency BKS by completing quests and exploring areas, which can be used to buy game assets and digital art on our digital Art Marketplace.

6. Immerse yourself in the Backrooms world of the game's unique art style and audio design.

7. You can trade digital art elements in games on our digital Art Marketplace, providing you with the opportunity to try new things and possibilities.

8. Backrooms supports multiple platforms, including Windows, iOS and Android.

In Backrooms, you become a member of this mysterious maze, exploring this AI-powered digital world with other players, enjoying your journey and experiencing the gaming differences made possible by digital art and blockchain technology. Come and join us as we explore Backrooms!
